notes: Refined existing stories to align tightly with ClinicalTrials.gov status handling and facade integration; no new IDs created.

change_log.value: Define normalized schema for ClinicalTrials.gov recruitment statuses (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, WITHDRAWN, UNKNOWN) and a scoring contract including numeric score, categorical label, and human-readable explanation.
change_log.note: Expanded to reflect actual CT.gov status set

change_log.value: Implement deterministic mapping from normalized recruitment status to score and label, including handling of CT.gov-specific statuses and safe defaults for null, unexpected, or deprecated values.

Integrate recruitment status scoring into EvaluateCare facade response contract so each trial includes score, label, and explanation fields, ensuring compatibility with existing clinical trials response structure.
Create unit tests validating score outputs for all supported CT.gov statuses and edge cases including null, unknown, mixed-case, and deprecated inputs.
Validate end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov ingestion (including RECRUITING filter behavior) through normalization, scoring, and EvaluateCare facade output to ensure consistency and correctness.
change_log.note: Added validation of upstream filter behavior
